input.quote: (i) The Servicer will indemnify the Issuer, the Owner Trustee and the Indenture Trustee (including in its capacity as Note Paying Agent), and their officers, directors, employees and agents (each, an "Indemnified Person") for all fees, expenses, losses, claims, actions, suits, damages and liabilities (including reasonable legal fees and expenses) resulting from the Servicer's (including in its capacity as Custodian) willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence in performing its obligations under the Transaction Documents
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance covenant of any kind. The only "insurance" references are Obligor insurance premiums billed to wireless accounts (p0095) and FDIC deposit insurance in the "Qualified Institution" definition (p0903); a search for "errors and omissions" and "fidelity bond" returns nothing. Cellco, as Servicer/Custodian, collects payments, holds Receivable Files and processes Obligor account data on behalf of the Issuer and Depositor, so it is squarely a services provider that touches our data — the position the playbook treats as walk-away territory when uninsured. The Servicer indemnity at p0291 is limited to willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence and provides no insured capacity, so it does not reach even the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M). We therefore inserted a short insurance covenant at the preferred limits as new Section 10.14 in Article X (Miscellaneous), permitting self-insurance and offering the fallback limits, which is proportionate given Cellco's credit standing and the Parent Support Agreement.

proposal.summary: Insert a Servicer insurance covenant (CGL, E&O and cyber) in Article X Miscellaneous
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Servicer performs collection and custodial services and processes Obligor account data, so we have added our standard insurance covenant (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, certificates on request); indemnity alone does not substitute for insured capacity. If helpful, we can accept our fallback of E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M, with self-insurance permitted.

ops.text: Insurance. The Servicer shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (i) commercial general liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence and $2,000,000 in the aggregate; (ii) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than $2,000,000; and (iii) cyber liability insurance of not less than $5,000,000 covering the Servicer's processing of Obligor information and other confidential information of the Issuer and the Depositor. Such coverage may be satisfied through a combination of primary, excess and self-insurance programs. The Servicer shall provide certificates of insurance to the Issuer and the Depositor on request.
